item.title: Assam’s Opposition Tests the Idea of Unity as 2026 Polls Nears, but Seats Still Divided
item.description: GUWAHATI: As the 2026 Assam Assembly elections draw closer, the state’s opposition parties are once again exploring the possibility of a united front against the BJP-led government. While the tempo of consultations has clearly increased, the exercise remains weighed down by an old and familiar obstacle: who contests which seat. item.title: Fire Guts Scrap Shop in Guwahati’s Gopinath Nagar, No Casualties Reported
item.description: GUWAHATI: A massive fire broke out at a scrap shop in Guwahati’s Gopinath Nagar area at around 9:30 pm on Tuesday, February 3, reducing the establishment to ashes. Fortunately, no casualties were reported in the incident.
